title: Log rotation
description: Defaults for rotating the Mac's job logs in place (LaunchAgent com.jacobr.log-rotate). A log's own policy, set in the Logs section, overrides these for that file only.

settings.name: max_mb
settings.label: Rotate above
settings.description: A log larger than this is archived and emptied at the next hourly check.

settings.name: keep
settings.label: Archives to keep
settings.description: How many rotated copies (<log>.1.gz to <log>.N.gz) stay beside the log. Per-file policies can explicitly choose 0 to discard contents on rotation.

settings.name: warn_total_mb
settings.label: Warn above total
settings.description: The status turns to a warning when logs plus archives together exceed this.
